stories.title: Libyan state entity fails to lift French attachment
stories.summary: A Kuwaiti company seeking to enforce a billion-dollar award against Libya has persuaded a Paris court to uphold an attachment of assets belonging to the state’s national oil company.
stories.flag_reason: matched ‘attachment of assets’ in the text

stories.title: Russia loses Singapore immunity appeal in Yukos saga
stories.summary: The Singapore Court of Appeal has upheld an order allowing the former majority shareholders of Yukos Oil Company to enforce awards now worth more than US$66 billion against Russia, finding the state’s immunity defence was precluded by transnational issue estoppel.

stories.title: Mitsui & v. Spain — mitsui & Co., Ltd
stories.summary: Mitsui & brought the claim against Spain under the ECT (Energy Charter Treaty), in the electric power and other energy sector; it was registered on December 12, 2025 (Respondent(s)). White & Case acts for the claimant. Abogacía General del Estado, Ministry of Justice of the Government of Spain for Spain. The tribunal is Quentin Loh, presiding; Patrick Leonard; Anne Marie Mürrle Rojas. On 22 September 2026, mitsui & Co., Ltd. Files a counter-memorial on annulment.

stories.title: Energía y Renovación v. Guatemala — energía y Renovación Holding S.A. files a counter-memorial on annulment
stories.summary: Energía y Renovación brought the claim against Guatemala under the FTA Central America - Panama 2002, in the electric power and other energy sector; it was registered on 29 October 2025. Hogan Lovells Cadwalader US LLP acts for the claimant. Ministry of Economy, Guatemala City, Guatemala, Procuraduría General de la Nación, Guatemala City, Guatemala and Three Crowns for Guatemala. The tribunal is Paul Arrighi Bustamante, presiding; Ximena Herrera-bernal; Attila Massimiliano Tanzi. On 21 September 2026, energía y Renovación Holding S.A. files a counter-memorial on annulment.
